verdict.rationale: Windows documents running on a broad range of OEM hardware form factors and keeping compatibility with existing devices and accessories, which covers the hardware-choice part of the story. The 'without vendor lock-in' part is undercut by concrete community reports: setup hides the local-account option and pushes users toward a Microsoft account, so users need workarounds like going offline or entering fake phone numbers. missing for 10: documented freedom from Microsoft account/vendor lock-in during install, documented hardware requirements and installation on arbitrary or self-built hardware, independent hands-on corroboration of broad hardware support.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can install and use the OS without vendor lock-in on hardware of my choosing

citations.quote: Choose from flexible 2-in-1s, slim laptops, powerful gaming PCs and more, across a range of display size, memory, and storage options.
